label: Fires at D2 when a1 rarely reaches S2, strongest after a2 trials or a rewarded a1-S2 trial.
terms: (in_state == 2) * (in_action == 1) ;; (in_state == 2) * (in_action == 1) * last_is("a1 S2 r") ;; (in_state == 2) * (in_action == 1) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (in_state == 2) * (in_action == 1) * (prev_action == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (in_state == 2) * (in_action == 1) * belief_lo ;; (in_state == 2) * (in_action == 1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (in_state == 2) * (in_action == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 2) ;; (in_state == 2) * (in_action == 1) * last_is("a1 S1 u")
explanation: Activity is confined to D2 of trials where a1 was chosen and the rare transition reached S2 (zero at D1/GO and on the other choice x state cells); that gate alone gives about 0.17 R^2 beyond timing on dev. How strongly it fires depends on the previous trial. It is largest when the previous trial was also a1 -> S2 rewarded (weight about +1.1 over the base), and large when the previous choice was a2 (about +0.6), especially a rewarded a2 trial. In both cases the last outcome pointed toward a2/S2, so this a1 choice went against the recent evidence. The base a1 -> S2 cell after a1 -> S1 trials stays weak. The free fit adds the extra boost for a rewarded previous a2 trial, a small negative graded belief_lo term (stronger when the observer favours S2) and the reward two trials back, going from about 0.40 to 0.48 on dev. Only observed quantities are used: at D2 the current choice and state are inputs.
